properties.name: p1_div_rem_c11_identity
properties.formal: forall a in i64, b in i64, b != 0: eval_i64(SDiv,a,b)*b + eval_i64(SRem,a,b) == a (wrapping) && |SRem| < |b| && sign(r) in {0, sign(a)}; same over u64 bits for UDiv/URem

properties.name: p2_div_by_zero_none_iff_zero_rhs
properties.formal: forall op in {SDiv,UDiv,SRem,URem}, a, b: eval_i64(op,a,b).is_none() iff b == 0; can_trap(op) iff op in that set

properties.name: p3_eval_i64_i128_consistency
properties.formal: forall op in IrBinOp, a >= 0, b >= 0 with exact result fitting i64: eval_i128(op,a,b) == eval_i64(op,a,b) (shifts: k < 64)

properties.name: p4_cmp_coherence_f64 (+p4b_cmp_coherence_i64)
properties.formal: forall a,b in f64 (incl NaN/inf/-0): eval_f64(Slt,a,b) == eval_f64(Ult,a,b) (all 4 pairs) && Ne == (a != b); forall a,b in i64: duality/reflection laws and two's-complement sign-region laws

properties.name: p5_unsigned_repr_writer_differential
properties.formal: forall ty in {U8,U16,U32}, v in [0, 2^bits): from_i64(v,ty).to_i64() == v && cast_float_to_target(v as f64,ty).to_i64() == v && cast_long_double_to_target(v,bytes,ty).to_i64() == v

properties.name: p6_coerce_to_unsigned_normalization
properties.formal: forall ty in {U8,U16}, v in (2^(bits-1), 2^bits): from_i64(v, signed(ty)).coerce_to(ty).to_i64() == v

properties.name: p7_f128_x87_encoding_roundtrip (+p7b_special_values)
properties.formal: forall v in finite f64 (incl subnormals): ieee_decode_f128(f64_to_f128_bytes(v)) == v && ieee_decode_x87(f64_to_x87_bytes(v)) == v; sign bits preserved; inf/NaN fields correct
properties.counterexample: f64_to_f128_bytes(5e-324) decodes to 1.1125369292536e-308 != 5e-324 (x87 twin equally wrong for subnormals)

properties.name: p8_zero_one_bool_contracts
properties.formal: forall ty in IrType (15 enumerators): zero(ty).is_zero() && one(ty).is_nonzero(); from_i64/to_i64 round-trip for signed; forall c in IrConst: bool_normalize(c) == I8(is_zero(c) ? 0 : 1)

properties.name: p9_build_cfg_transpose_consistency
properties.formal: forall CFG F over blocks with resolved labels: forall i,b: multiplicity of edge (i->b) in succs equals its multiplicity in preds && no duplicate entries in either
properties.counterexample: block0: CondBranch{true:L1,false:L1}; block1: Return -> preds[1] = [0,0], succs[0] = [1]

properties.name: p10_dominators_vs_naive_reference
properties.formal: forall graph G (1..=8 nodes, entry 0): idom_SUT(G) == idom_naive(G) on reachable nodes && idom[b] == MAX iff b unreachable && idom[0] == 0; RPO covers each reachable block once

properties.name: p11_frontiers_vs_definition (+p11b_entry_selfloop_df red witness)
properties.formal: forall graph G without edges into entry: DF_SUT(b) == {d reachable : exists p in preds(d), b dominates p, and (d == b or b does not strictly dominate d)}; witness p11b (red): entry in any cycle => entry in DF(entry)
properties.counterexample: n=1, succs=[[0]] (entry self-loop): DF(0) = {} but definition requires {0}; also 0->1->{0,1} cycle form

properties.name: p12_promote_yields_valid_ssa
properties.formal: forall alloca-based IR F (random CFG, k in 0..=4 allocas, random load/store): promote(F) has (a) no remaining use of a promoted alloca, (b) every reachable-block phi has exactly one incoming per unique reachable predecessor, (c) every use dominated by its def (phi uses at the incoming block), (d) next_value_id bounds all ids

properties.name: p13_phi_elimination_structural_preservation
properties.formal: forall F' = eliminate_phis(promote(F)): (a) no Phi remains, (b) every terminator label resolves, (c) trampolines are pure copy blocks branching to original labels, (d) every USED former phi dest is defined by some Copy

bugs.summary: cast_float_to_target / cast_long_double_to_target store U8/U16 constants in sign-extending native variants, violating the documented zero-extension convention
bugs.impact: constant folding / GVN / algebraic simplification read unsigned constants above the signed range (U8 > 127, U16 > 32767) as negative after any float->int constant cast — silent wrong folded values
bugs.expected: cast_float_to_target(200.0, U8).to_i64() == Some(200) (I64(200) per the from_i64 convention)
bugs.fix: Store U8/U16 as IrConst::I64(v as u8 as i64) / I64(v as u16 as i64) in both cast functions, mirroring from_i64 and narrowed_to
bugs.documentedBehavior: "Store unsigned sub-64-bit types (U8, U16, U32) as I64 with zero-extended values to preserve unsigned semantics." — src/ir/constants.rs:437

bugs.summary: coerce_to_with_src early-return keeps the forbidden sign-extending I8/I16 variant for U8/U16 targets
bugs.impact: the universal constant-to-instruction-type coercion step produces constants that read back negative through to_i64() for U8/U16 values above their signed range
bugs.fix: Split the early-return arms: (I8(_), I8) may return *self but (I8(_), U8) must fall through to from_i64 normalization (same for I16/U16)
bugs.documentedBehavior: "Store unsigned sub-64-bit types (U8, U16, U32) as I64 with zero-extended values to preserve unsigned semantics." — src/ir/constants.rs:437

bugs.summary: f64 subnormals misencoded by f64_to_f128_bytes and f64_to_x87_bytes (treated as normals of the source width)
bugs.impact: subnormal constants flowing into long-double data emission produce wrong bytes on ARM64/RISC-V (f128 emitted verbatim) and wrong x87 constants on x86
bugs.counterexample: f64_to_f128_bytes(5e-324) decodes to 1.1125369292536e-308 != 5e-324 (x87 twin equally wrong for subnormals)
bugs.fix: Normalize subnormals (exp11 == 0 && mantissa52 != 0) before packing: find the leading one of mantissa52 and adjust the exponent; do not set the implicit integer bit from the raw mantissa
bugs.documentedBehavior: "Convert an f64 value to IEEE 754 binary128 (quad-precision) encoding (16 bytes, little-endian)." — src/ir/constants.rs:50

bugs.summary: build_cfg records duplicate predecessor entries for CondBranch with equal targets and Switch with duplicate case labels
bugs.impact: six passes consume preds counts (if_convert diamond gates, GVN join detection, mem2reg DF join gate and phi-cost estimate); currently masked effects but the transpose invariant they build on is violated
bugs.expected: preds and succs are exact transposes with no duplicates: preds[1] == [0]
bugs.counterexample: block0: CondBranch{true:L1,false:L1}; block1: Return -> preds[1] = [0,0], succs[0] = [1]
bugs.fix: Deduplicate the preds push symmetrically to the contains-guarded succs push in the CondBranch/Switch/IndirectBranch arms
bugs.documentedBehavior: "Build predecessor and successor lists from the function's CFG. Returns (preds, succs) as flat adjacency lists (CSR format)." — src/ir/analysis.rs:106

bugs.summary: compute_dominance_frontiers can never contain the entry block in its own frontier (entry cycles skipped by join gate and runner stop)
bugs.impact: if a future pass creates an entry cycle, mem2reg would omit the entry phi for loop-carried variables -> silent miscompile; not reachable from today's C lowering (no in-tree producer of edges into entry)
bugs.expected: DF(entry) contains entry whenever entry is in any cycle (Cytron DF_local)
bugs.counterexample: n=1, succs=[[0]] (entry self-loop): DF(0) = {} but definition requires {0}; also 0->1->{0,1} cycle form
bugs.fix: Add the local-frontier pass: for every block b and successor y, if b does not strictly dominate y, insert y into DF(b) (subsumes the entry case)
bugs.documentedBehavior: "Compute dominance frontiers for each block. DF(b) = set of blocks where b's dominance ends (join points)." — src/ir/analysis.rs:302
